# Local display assets

The panel loads these files locally; rendering does not request a CDN.

| Files | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `three.core.min.js`, `three.module.min.js`, `FontLoader.js`, `RoomEnvironment.js`, `TextGeometry.js` | Three.js, npm package `three` version 0.180.0 | [MIT](THREE-LICENSE.txt) |
| `helvetiker_bold.typeface.json` | Three.js example font, Helvetiker Bold (Magenta Ltd, 2004) | [Embedded font license](HELVETIKER-LICENSE.txt) |

The font notice is reproduced from `original_font_information.license_description`
in the shipped JSON. It has its own license, separate from the Three.js code.
